code.description: Stable snake_case identifier within a jurisdiction (e.g. "milk").

action.description: Dot-namespaced event name. Examples: recipe.approved, product.created.

auditable_id.description: Primary key of the audited record (UUID string).

user_id.description: UUID of the acting user. Null for system/background job events.

cart_timeout_minutes.description: Override cart timeout for this branch. Null = inherit from brand default.

point_earn_amount.description: Override the point-earn money unit for this branch. Null = inherit from brand default.

point_earn_points.description: Override the points granted per money unit for this branch. Null = inherit from brand default.

takeaway_payment_timeout_minutes.description: Override takeaway payment timeout for this branch. Null = inherit from brand default.

allow_shop_edit_hq_tables.displayName: Shops may edit HQ default tables

snapshot.description: Compact price/tax map the verifier re-prices historical offline orders against: menu_product_sku_id → [product_sku_id, price, tax_type_id].

snapshot_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical price map. Equal hash = no new revision (BR-CR02).

address.description: Full address for delivery or VAT invoice

birthday.description: Date of birth, self-declared by the customer

branch.description: Branch (shop) where this customer was registered (null for self-registered)

brand.description: Brand this customer belongs to (null for self-registered customers)

first_name.description: First name (given name) of the customer

last_name.description: Last name (family name) of the customer or company name (for VAT invoice)

loyalty_opted_in.description: Whether the customer joined the membership programme (points + tiers)

note.description: Internal note about this customer (e.g., allergies, preferences)

phone.description: Primary contact phone number. Used to look up returning customers (BR-C01)

tax_code.description: Company tax identification number for VAT invoices (BR-C02)

branch.description: Device is scoped to a specific branch.

device_info.description: Hardware/OS metadata reported by device on pair. Example: {os: 'iOS 18', model: 'iPad Pro 13', app_version: '0.1.0'}.

device_token.description: Long-lived auth token. Set on pair, cleared on revoke (BR-D02, BR-D04). Never expose in list endpoints.

last_seen_at.description: Updated on each API call from device. Used for heartbeat monitoring.

name.description: Friendly name, unique per branch (BR-D06). Example: TMS-Reception, TMS-Floor2.

pairing_code.description: 6-char uppercase alphanumeric. Short-lived (15 min). Cleared after successful pair (BR-D01, BR-D03).

pairing_expires_at.description: Timestamp when pairing_code expires. Null after pair.

policies.desc: Device overrides are upserted through scoped admin flows; hard delete uses reset semantics
Device restriction may only inherit or disable; widening is enforced in authorization service

expires_at.description: Validity ceiling. Default 180 days from issue; rotation issues a fresh key rather than extending.

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key, base64 (44 chars). The device keeps the private half.

cost_at_disposal.description: Snapshot of cost_price (variant) or calculated_cost (material) at disposal creation time. BR-04.

disposal_reason.description: Fixed enum classifying why the item is being disposed. BR-05: users cannot add custom reasons.

note.description: Optional note. Required when disposal_reason=other (BR-02). App-level validation.

stockTransactionItem.description: 1-1 mapping with stock_transaction_items. Each disposal item has exactly one disposal record.

fired_at.description: When ExpiryAlertService::scan() created this row. Set on insert via DB DEFAULT.

notification_id.description: Soft FK to notifications.id when a notification was successfully dispatched. NULL = create-only path (notification deferred to a future Tier 1.C polish).

threshold_days.description: Days-out window that fired this alert (e.g. 7, 3, 1).

branch_id.description: References branches.id. No hard FK — observation counter, fail-open (#2609).

business_date.description: The BRANCH's calendar day via BusinessClock (#1091), never the database's or the app's.

device_id.description: References devices.id. No hard FK — observation counter, fail-open (#2609).

legacy_field.description: The legacy wire name that actually supplied the value: payment_option_id | connection_id | option_id.

route.description: Client family of the payment route: workstation | kiosk (or unknown when unattributable).

end_date.description: Optional calendar-date upper bound. NULL = no upper bound.

is_active.description: Simple on/off toggle — no approval workflow like Menu.

name.description: Display name for this floating section (e.g. "Happy Hour 17:00-19:00")

priority.description: Tiebreak ordering when multiple floating sections are active at once.

start_date.description: Optional calendar-date lower bound (e.g. a seasonal promo). NULL = no lower bound.

taxType.description: Floating-section-item tax type override. Null = inherit from the product.

is_active.description: SKU-level toggle. Can deactivate an individual variant (e.g. one size out of stock).

is_price_overridden.description: Whether selling_price has been customized. False right after create/reset.

selling_price.description: Promotional price for this variant. Initially copied from product_skus.selling_price; HQ/shop can override.

FloatingSectionProductToppingItemOverrid.name: FloatingSectionProductToppingItemOverride
FloatingSectionProductToppingItemOverrid.displayName: Floating Section Product Topping Item Override

floatingSectionProduct.description: Shop-scoped floating section product this override applies to

is_hidden.description: Hide this topping item for this floating section product at shop level

override_price.description: Shop override extra price. Null = inherit from HQ override or topping_group_item_skus

productSku.description: Null = wildcard override for all SKUs of this topping item

days_of_week.description: Bitmask, bit0=Sun...bit6=Sat. Same encoding as menu_schedules.days_of_week.

child_lot.description: The lot produced from this consumption. NULL on sales edges (terminates in customer_order). RESTRICT — a referenced child lot cannot be hard-deleted (plan-040 C4).

consumed_at.description: When consumption physically happened (batch start / order close). Distinct from created_at — used in FSMA-204 timeline reports.

customer_order_id.description: Soft FK to customer_orders.id when source_event_type=customer_order. NULL on production / disposal edges.

parent_lot.description: The consumed lot. Always set. RESTRICT — a lot referenced by genealogy cannot be hard-deleted (plan-040 C4).

qty_consumed.description: Positive qty drawn from parent_lot in this event. Recall reports use this to compute distribution percentages.

source_event_id.description: Soft FK to the row identified by source_event_type. e.g. material_batches.id when source_event_type=material_batch.

source_event_type.description: Discriminator for source_event_id. Known values: material_batch | customer_order | disposal | manual_adjustment. NOT an enum — keeps future events extensible.

unit.description: Unit of qty_consumed. Must match parent_lot.unit (denormalized for reporting).

calculated_cost.description: Cached cost — written by the HQ admin or computed via the linked Recipe.

expiry_alert_thresholds.description: JSON array of days, e.g. [7, 3, 1]. NULL = use system default.

outputSku.description: The SKU produced from this material/recipe

shelf_life_days.description: Days from production until expiry. NULL = no policy. Used by MaterialBatchService::complete to compute output lot expiry.

yield_unit.description: Unit of output (e.g., PORTION, LITER, GRAM)

actual_yield.description: Actual output recorded on completion. May differ from planned (BR-08: waste, spoilage)

approved_by_id.description: SSO user who approved this batch. Null if not yet approved.

created_by_id.description: SSO user who created this batch (user_caches.id). No hard FK.

expiry_date.description: Expiry date of the output product (set on completion)

material_id.description: FK to materials — the material being produced. Must have non-empty components (BR-01)

multiplier.description: Number of batches (1 = 1 recipe, 2 = double). All component quantities are multiplied by this (BR-02)

outputLot.description: MaterialLot minted on complete() with source=production. NULL until completed (or for legacy pre-plan-017 batches). SET NULL on lot delete preserves audit.

recipe.description: Recipe snapshot used to expand this batch. RESTRICT on delete preserves audit.

started_at.description: When batch processing started (approved → in_progress transition)

status.description: Workflow: draft → pending → approved → in_progress → completed / cancelled

stock_in_transaction_id.description: FK to stock_transactions — auto-created when batch completes (add output). No hard FK.

stock_out_transaction_id.description: FK to stock_transactions — auto-created when batch starts (deduct components). No hard FK.

warehouse.description: Production warehouse where components are consumed and output is stored

yield_unit.description: Output unit from material recipe (e.g., kg, LITER, piece)

yield_variance_reason.description: Operator-supplied reason when actual_yield deviates beyond the recipe's tolerance %.

actual_quantity.description: Actual amount used, recorded on batch completion. May differ from planned.

component_type.description: material = raw material (BR-04), variant = product variant (BR-05)

material.description: Raw material component. Active when component_type = material (BR-04)

materialBatch.description: Parent batch. Items are cascade-deleted with the batch.

materialLot.description: Lot allocated to satisfy this component. Stamped by MaterialBatchService::start via FEFO. Multi-lot allocations split into N item rows. NULL = legacy/variant component.

productSku.description: Product variant component. Active when component_type = variant (BR-05)

stock_available.description: Snapshot of available stock at batch creation time (for UI display only)

unit.description: Base unit for this component. Must match stock_levels.unit (BR-10)

brand.description: Brand denormalized from material.brand_id. Enables HQ filter without joining materials. CASCADE consistent with material policy.

coa_urls.description: JSON map of language → CoA document URL. Migrated from single coa_url field.

cost_per_unit.description: Lot-grain cost. Stamped on stock_transaction_items.cost_basis_amount during FEFO pick. NULL = falls back to material.calculated_cost in COGS reports.

effective_allergens.description: JSON array of allergen ids snapshotted at creation. Inbound = material allergens; Production = UNION of consumed lots. Drift vs master triggers SafetyEvent.

entered_quantity.description: Original quantity as entered by the operator (pre-conversion). NULL for legacy lots before T1.

entered_unit.description: Unit operator selected at entry time (e.g., bag_25kg). Resolved to base unit via material_units.ratio. NULL for legacy lots.

expiry_date.description: Day this lot expires. FEFO sorts ASC by this column. NULL allowed (e.g., shelf-stable salt) but discouraged for HACCP-relevant materials.

lot_code.description: Inbound: L-{sku}-{YYYYMMDD}-{NNN}. Production: parent MaterialBatch.batch_code reused. Unique per organization.

material.description: FK to materials. RESTRICT delete — lot must be disposed before material can be removed.

organization.description: Owning organization. CASCADE delete — when an org leaves, its lots go with it.

produced_by_batch.description: FK to material_batches when source=production. NULL for inbound lots. SET NULL on batch delete — lot remains for trace.

qty_on_hand.description: Cached qty remaining. Decremented by StockTransactionService on stock_out. When reaches 0, lot status flips to depleted.

quarantine_reason.description: Free-text reason captured on quarantine. Cleared (or kept for audit) on release. Visible in audit timeline.

received_at.description: When the lot physically arrived. May predate created_at when entries are backdated. For production lots = MaterialBatch.completed_at.

received_qty.description: Quantity received at lot creation. Immutable. Used by recall + audit reports to compute distribution percentages.

received_temperature.description: Cold-chain reading at receipt. Compared to material.temperature_min/max for is_temperature_compliant.

source.description: inbound = supplier delivery; production = output from a MaterialBatch.

status.description: active → quarantined ⇄ active → depleted | expired | disposed. Only `active` is FEFO-eligible.

supplier_lot_code.description: Supplier's printed lot code (carton/pallet label). Distinct from our internal lot_code. Helps cross-reference recalls issued by the supplier.

supplier_name.description: Free-text supplier name (no FK; Supplier entity = plan-019). NULL when source=production.

unit.description: Base unit denormalized from material.base_unit. Receive form converts received qty into this unit before persisting.

warehouse.description: Warehouse holding this lot. Lots do NOT migrate across warehouses — transfer = dispose-and-receive (plan-022).

auto_substitute.description: Off by default. When true, pickLotsForConsumption falls back to the substitute automatically once the primary is exhausted.

conversion_factor.description: Qty multiplier. 1.0 = 1:1 replacement. 1.1 = need 10% more substitute.

primaryMaterial.description: The material that may run out of stock and need substitution.

priority.description: Lower number = higher priority. Used to order fallback candidates.

substituteMaterial.description: The material that can be used in place of the primary.

is_base.description: Only one base unit per material (auto-created during sync, BR-09)

cart_timeout_minutes.description: Override cart timeout in minutes. Null = inherit from branch or brand default.

clonedMenus.description: Branch menus cloned from this master menu

is_master.description: Whether this is a master/template menu

last_synced_at.description: Last time this menu was synced with master

masterMenu.description: The master menu this was cloned from

menuSections.description: Sections/categories grouping products within this menu

priority.description: Priority in branch (lower number = higher priority). MUST be unique per branch.

service_type.description: Which ordering flow shows this menu. Both = takeaway + dine-in. NULL on a branch menu = inherit the master (HQ) menu's service type.

taxType.description: Tax type for every line of this menu. Null = inherit from the product (resolver tier 3).

valid_from.description: Start date of menu validity (null = no start limit)

valid_to.description: End date of menu validity (null = no end limit)

display_order.description: Order of this section within the menu (lower = first)

taxType.description: Tax type for this section within this menu. Null = inherit from the menu (resolver tier 2).

display_order.description: Order for display within the menu (lower = first)

is_active.description: Product-level toggle. When false, all SKUs under this product are hidden regardless of their individual is_active.

masterMenuProduct.description: Points to the master menu's row for sync tracking. Null for master menus.

menuSection.description: Section this product is grouped under inside the menu. To put one product in multiple sections, create multiple menu_products rows with the same product_id but different menu_section_id values.

product.description: The product added to this menu

taxType.description: Menu-level tax type override. Null = inherit from the product (resolver §7 tier 1).

is_active.description: SKU-level toggle. Branch can deactivate individual SKUs (e.g. out of a specific size).

is_price_overridden.description: Whether the branch has customized selling_price. True when branch explicitly sets a price (even if same as default). False after clone or reset.

productSku.description: The specific SKU within the product

selling_price.description: Branch selling price. Initially copied from product_skus.selling_price during clone. Branch can override.

is_hidden.description: Hide this topping item for this menu product at branch level

menuProduct.description: Branch-scoped menu product this override applies to

override_price.description: Branch override extra price. Null = inherit from HQ override or topping_group_item_skus

productSku.description: Null = wildcard override for all SKUs of this topping item

is_featured.description: Show this section's items in the customer featured carousel

name.description: Display name for this menu section

actor_id.description: PK of the actor record. Null iff `actor_type` is null (validated in service).

actor_type.description: Morph alias (e.g. 'user', 'device') — NOT a class path. Null for system events.

aggregation_key.description: Future-use grouping key for inbox collapse (e.g. `order.new:{shop_id}`). Persisted since Phase A but not rendered in v1; forward-compatible.

audience_id.description: FK to `notification_audiences.id` when dispatch came from a saved audience. Null when dispatch used an inline/code rule. FK constraint added when T12.1 creates the audiences table.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key to prevent duplicate dispatches on queue retry. Unique when non-null (enforced by unique index). Emitters MUST pass this for retry-safe events.

is_dispatched.description: Default `true` for now-send rows. Phase D composer sets `false` alongside `scheduled_for`; cron flips to `true` after dispatching at due time.

organization.description: Organization that owns this notification. Every inbox query filters by this.

params.description: Template parameters as JSON. E.g. {"recipe_name":"Gyoza","approver":"Tanaka"}. Substituted into template `{{param}}` tokens at response time.

priority.description: `low` / `normal` / `high` / `urgent`. Default `normal`. `urgent` bypasses master mute + quiet hours (Decision 10) but not type-specific opt-out.

scheduled_for.description: Future dispatch time. Null means 'send now'. When set, paired with `is_dispatched=false`; cron scans due rows every minute and fires dispatch at `scheduled_for`.

subject_id.description: PK of the subject record. Null-together with `subject_type` (app-level CHECK in dispatch service).

subject_type.description: Morph alias of the related entity (e.g. 'recipe', 'customer_order', 'stock_alert'). Null iff `subject_id` is null.

template_key.description: Template lookup key. In Phase A matches the FE i18n bundle key. In Phase B becomes a soft FK into `notification_templates.key` (no DB FK — lookup via service). Usually identical to `type` but allowed to diverge.

type.description: Dot-namespaced event name. Examples: `recipe.approved`, `stock.alert.low`, `system.broadcast`. Null actor + `system.*` type distinguishes system events.

branch.description: Shop scope. Set → audience editable under that shop's admin UI only; compose picker on the shop surface shows it. Null → HQ-managed (existing semantics; brand_id may still narrow the scope). When the dispatch is shop-scoped, the resolver intersects resolved recipients with that shop's memberships so a brand-wide audience picked by a shop admin can't fan out cross-shop.

brand.description: Brand scope. Set → audience editable under that brand's HQ; compose picker shows it only for that brand. Null → organization-scoped: any brand in the same organization may reference it; only HQ organization admins may edit.

createdBy.description: User who created this audience. SET NULL on user deletion so the audience and its audit trail survive the creator's account removal. Null for seeder-created rows (`is_system=true`).

description.description: Free-form notes on what the audience targets and why. Rendered as a secondary line under `name` in the picker.

is_system.description: `true` when seeded by `SystemNotificationAudienceSeeder` (e.g. 'All warehouse managers'). PATCH + DELETE on these rows return 403 — they're part of the platform baseline. `false` for user-created rows; fully editable.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in the compose audience picker and the admin list. Examples: 'All warehouse managers', 'Brand A shop staff', 'On-call engineers'. Unique per organization.

organization.description: Organization that owns this audience. Every query filters by this column.

rule.description: Rule JSON consumed by `AudienceResolverService`. Shape: `{version, combinator: 'or'|'and', rules: [...], exclude?: [...]}`. Each sub-rule `type` maps to a `*Resolver` class. See header comment for full schema and examples.

branch.description: Shop (branch) scope override. Null = brand/org-managed. Set = shop admin owns this routing override; lookup precedence is branch → brand → org/system at dispatch fan-out.

channels.description: JSON array of NotificationChannel cases, e.g. ['in_app','email']. Empty array disables the type entirely for this scope.

priority_overrides.description: Optional { <priority>: [<channel>, ...] } map — per-priority channel override. E.g. urgent → [in_app, realtime, email] for this type.

attempts.description: Retry counter; incremented by NotificationChannelJob on each send attempt. Null = never attempted (freshly-written row); the job normalizes to 0 before incrementing.

error.description: Exception message from the last failed attempt. Cleared when a subsequent attempt succeeds.

provider_ref.description: Provider-side identifier (email message id, push ticket, broadcast event id). Used to reconcile async delivery webhooks.

cadence.description: `off` (default — no digest), `daily`, or `weekly`. Eligibility check skips `off` rows entirely so the digest table can hold opt-out rows alongside opt-ins without affecting send throughput.

delivery_time.description: `HH:MM` in the user's `timezone`. Stored as String (not Time) to dodge DB-time-zone-conversion surprises across MySQL servers; the hourly scheduler parses with substr/intval so a 09:00 row only matches the 09:00–09:59 window in user.timezone.

include_priorities.description: JSON array of NotificationPriority values (default `["urgent","high","normal","low"]`). DigestBuilderService filters by this array so users can opt out of low-priority noise without losing urgent visibility.

last_sent_at.description: Updated by `SendDigestJob` after the Mailable is queued OR after an empty-window skip. The "last_sent_at < startOfDay(now())" guard prevents double-send on hourly re-fires and absorbs DST repeats.

timezone.description: IANA tz (`Asia/Tokyo` / `America/Los_Angeles`). Validated against `DateTimeZone::listIdentifiers()` on PATCH.

user.description: User this preference belongs to. One row per user (unique index).

weekday.description: Required when `cadence='weekly'`: 0=Sunday … 6=Saturday. Nullable otherwise. Validator enforces the cadence×weekday relationship; the schema is permissive.

email.description: RFC 5321 max length is 254 chars. Address normalised lower-case at write time so two casings of the same address can't both bypass the suppression check.

organization.description: Tenancy boundary. EmailChannel filters by this on every send.

reason.description: Why the address is suppressed. Closed enum at the controller layer: `hard_bounce` | `spam_complaint` | `subscription_change` | `manual`. Future providers (SES, Mailgun) emit different event names that the per-driver MailWebhookContract maps onto this enum.

source_provider.description: Mail provider that surfaced the suppression event (`postmark` / `ses` / `mailgun` / `manual`). Nullable to ease later provider additions without a backfill migration. Useful for diagnostics when ops asks "where did this suppression come from?".

suppressed_at.description: When the suppression took effect. Set at insert time; never updated after.

un_suppressed_at.description: When the admin removed the suppression (`DELETE /email-suppressions/{id}`). Writes here rather than deleting the row so the audit trail survives. EmailChannel ignores rows where this is non-null — they're effectively un-suppressed but the history is preserved for diagnostics.

channel.description: NotificationChannel case value, or literal `*` for the master-level row.

quiet_from.description: HH:MM 24h local time. Only set on the master-level row.

quiet_timezone.description: IANA tz id (e.g. Asia/Tokyo). Falls back to user.timezone then Asia/Tokyo when null.

quiet_to.description: HH:MM 24h local time. Wraps across midnight when `quiet_to` < `quiet_from`.

type.description: Notification type string, or literal `*` for the master-level preference row.

dismissed_at.description: Timestamp when the user archived/cleared the row. Dismissed rows disappear from default `/me/notifications` responses. Soft-flag (not a hard delete) — retention pruning eventually removes rows anyway.

notification.description: Parent content row. Cascade-delete when the parent is pruned by retention.

read_at.description: Timestamp when the user explicitly interacted (clicked the row, opened detail). Idempotent. Setting `read_at` also implies `seen_at` (the controller sets both if `seen_at` is still null).

recipient_id.description: PK of the recipient record (User or Device UUID). Never null.

recipient_type.description: Morph alias — `user` or `device`. Never null; every recipient row must resolve through the morph map in AppServiceProvider::boot.

resolved_via.description: Trace string from `AudienceResolverService` explaining how this recipient was reached. Examples: `role:warehouse_manager:{warehouse_id}`, `user:direct`, `shop:{shop_id}:members`. Null when the dispatch path passed an explicit recipient Collection without going through the resolver.

seen_at.description: Timestamp when the notification entered the user's viewport / inbox was opened. Idempotent — once set, subsequent seen calls do not overwrite.

action.description: `{template_key, audience_rule, priority, channels, param_template?}`. param_template lets the admin reference fields off the firing model (e.g. `{warehouse_name: "$model.warehouse.name"}`).

branch.description: Shop (branch) scope. Set → editable only by shop_admin of that branch; the shop rule editor inherits brand-level rules read-only.

brand.description: Brand scope. Set → rule editable only under HQ. Null = org-scoped.

conditions.description: JSON DSL tree. Node = `{combinator: and|or, children: [...]}`. Leaf = `{field, op, value?}`. 13 supported ops; dotted field paths up to depth 3 (data_get). Validated by `RuleDslValidator`; max depth 5, max 50 leaves.

cooldown_minutes.description: Minimum minutes between consecutive fires for the same (rule, model_id). 0 = always fire. The EvaluateRuleJob queries notification_rule_firings BEFORE evaluating conditions, so a cooldown skip writes one firing row but no notification.

createdBy.description: User who authored the rule. SET NULL on user deletion so rules outlive their author.

description.description: Free-form admin notes; not shown to recipients.

fire_count.description: Total successful (outcome=matched) fires since rule creation. Diagnostics counter; the audit trail in notification_rule_firings is authoritative.

is_active.description: Rules ship inactive — admin enables explicitly after dry-run. System rules (SystemNotificationRuleSeeder) also start inactive; parallel-shadow validates parity with hardcoded emitters before flip.

last_fired_at.description: Updated by EvaluateRuleJob after a successful (outcome=matched) fire. NOT updated for skipped_cooldown / skipped_condition outcomes.

name.description: Human-readable rule label rendered in admin lists. Free-text.

organization.description: Tenancy boundary. Every bridge lookup filters by this.

trigger_event.description: `model.created` / `model.updated` / `model.deleted` for Eloquent triggers, OR `custom.<name>` for non-Eloquent triggers (plan-023 M8 scheduled detectors).

trigger_model_type.description: Morph alias of the watched Eloquent model when trigger_event is `model.*` (e.g. "Recipe", "CustomerOrder"). Null on `custom.*` triggers.

error_message.description: Captured throwable message when outcome=error. Null for every other outcome.

evaluation_trace.description: Per-leaf pass/fail breakdown produced by RuleEvaluatorService::evaluate. Powers the admin "why didn't this fire?" debug view. Shape: `[{field, op, expected, actual, pass}, …]`.

fired_at.description: When the EvaluateRuleJob processed the trigger. Indexed for the per-rule firings page.

model_id.description: Primary key of the firing model row. String to absorb UUID and bigInt PKs alike. Null on custom.* triggers.

model_type.description: Morph alias of the firing Eloquent model. Null on custom.* event triggers.

notification.description: Dispatched notification (outcome=matched only). SET NULL on notification delete so the firing row survives Prunable retention.

rule.description: Parent rule. Cascade-delete with the rule so orphaned firing rows can't pile up.

audience.description: NotificationAudience the schedule fires at. RESTRICT delete — admin must cancel the schedule explicitly before deleting the underlying audience (prevents silent loss of an active recurrence).

brand.description: Brand scope. Required — recurring broadcasts always target one brand. Cascade-delete with the brand so orphaned schedules can't fire.

channels.description: Array of NotificationChannel enum values applied to every occurrence (e.g. `['in_app', 'email']`). Multi-select on composer step 3. Defaults to the template's `default_channels` if omitted at create time.

createdBy.description: User who created this schedule. SET NULL on user deletion so the schedule and its history survive the creator's account removal.

ends_at.description: Last eligible occurrence (inclusive). Nullable → schedule runs indefinitely until `occurrences_remaining` exhausts (if set) or admin cancels. Flips `status` to `completed` once tick observes `next_occurrence_at > ends_at`.

last_occurrence_at.description: Most recent successful occurrence (UTC). Updated by `RecurringNotificationDispatcher::tick` immediately after a Notification row is written + before next_occurrence_at advances. Useful for admin diagnostics when a schedule's badge says "fired 3h ago".

next_occurrence_at.description: Next datetime the tick worker will materialise (UTC). Computed by `\\Recurr\\Transformer\\ArrayTransformer` at create time + after every tick. Null when status is terminal (`completed`/`cancelled`).

occurrences_remaining.description: "Send N more times" counter. Nullable means no count limit (use `ends_at` instead, or run indefinitely). Tick decrements on every successful materialise; hits 0 → status flips to `completed`, next_occurrence_at goes null.

organization.description: Organization that owns this schedule. Every query filters by this.

params.description: Token substitution bag for `TemplateRenderer::render` (e.g. `{warehouse_name: 'Tokyo HQ', threshold: 100}`). Nullable — templates without `{{tokens}}` need no params.

priority.description: NotificationPriority enum value (`low` | `normal` | `high` | `urgent`). Drives the urgent-bypass rule in EffectiveChannelService — urgent occurrences ignore master_mute + quiet_hours but still honour per-(type × channel) opt-out.

rrule.description: RFC-5545 RRULE substring (no `BEGIN:VEVENT`/`END:VEVENT` wrapper). Examples: `FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=9;BYMINUTE=0`, `FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR;BYHOUR=9`. Parsed by `\Recurr\Rule` at tick time; invalid RRULE → schedule create returns 422.

starts_at.description: First eligible occurrence. UTC. The RRULE iterator anchors from this datetime; occurrences before `starts_at` are skipped even if the RRULE would otherwise match.

status.description: Lifecycle state — `active` (tick materialises), `paused` (tick skips), `completed` (terminal, RRULE exhausted), `cancelled` (terminal, admin DELETE before freeze window). State transitions are: active ↔ paused, active → completed (tick), active → cancelled (admin), paused → cancelled (admin).

template_key.description: Soft pointer to `notification_templates.key` (not a FK — admin may delete a template and the schedule's lookup will fall back to a logged warning + literal key in the inbox). Examples: `stock.alert.low`, `system.weekly_digest`.

timezone.description: IANA tz name (e.g. `Asia/Tokyo`, `America/Los_Angeles`). Re-read on every tick so DST transitions advance the occurrence correctly. Validated against `DateTimeZone::listIdentifiers()` on create.

branch.description: Shop scope. When the renderer resolves a template_key the lookup order is shop → brand → system (org) → platform. Set means the row overrides the brand-level wording for that specific shop. is_system is always false on shop-scoped rows.

brand.description: Brand scope. Null = org-scoped (when organization_id is set) or platform-scoped (when both are null). Brand-scoped row wins over org / platform rows at render time.

content.description: Locale-keyed content: `{ja:{title,body}, en:{title,body}, vi:{title,body}}`. Tokens `{{param}}` are substituted at render time from `notifications.params`. Missing token → empty + Log::warning (no throw).

createdBy.description: User who created this template. SET NULL on user deletion. Null for seeder-created rows (is_system=true).

default_channels.description: JSON array of NotificationChannel cases (M3 enum). Phase B rows ship with `['in_app']`; M3 T3.9 channel-routing layer reads this as the fallback when no brand / org route override exists. Nullable → treat as `['in_app']`.

is_system.description: `true` when seeded by `SystemNotificationTemplateSeeder`. PATCH + DELETE return 403 on these rows — admins override by creating a brand-scoped row with the same `key`.

key.description: Lookup key — joined to notifications.template_key. Examples: `stock.alert.low`, `recipe.approved`, `order.status_changed`. Unique globally.

organization.description: Organization that owns this template. Nullable — null means platform-wide (e.g. system rows seeded by SystemNotificationTemplateSeeder).

params_schema.description: Soft contract: `{required: [key, ...], optional: [key, ...]}`. Composer UI reads this to render the param-helper dropdown. Validated at seeder time for system templates; admin-created rows are not strictly validated.

policies.desc: Merchant connection mutations require ownership-aware authorization beyond schema policy
Safe display identity reads; secret refs remain hidden and are never returned by resources
Verified capability rows mutate only through connection validation flows with explicit auth
Capability state is readable for admin explanation within tenant scope
Capability catalog is release-managed; tenants cannot mutate provider option rows
Catalog read for admin/effective-policy explanation surfaces

code.description: Stable adapter registry code. Changing it is a compatibility migration, not a display edit.

policies.desc: Provider catalog is release-managed; tenants cannot mutate adapter registry rows
Catalog read for HQ/shop payment admin surfaces; credential fields are absent by schema

type.description: Stable behavior category. `on_account` records debt and is not external money movement.

policies.desc: Published effective-policy snapshots are append-only and never rewritten
Revision history is readable within tenant scope for convergence and audit

author.description: User who wrote the post. Nullable to preserve post when author is removed.

branch.description: NULL = organization-wide (HQ) post. Set = post owned by that branch alone.

content.description: Full article body. Markdown or sanitized HTML (service-enforced).

excerpt.description: Short summary for listings and social preview (recommended ≤ 280 chars).

is_pinned.description: When true, appears at top of listings regardless of published_at.

published_at.description: When the post goes public. Must be set AND status=Published AND in the past for post to be visible.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier for routing. Unique per organization.

color.description: Optional hex color for tag chip display (e.g. "#fff5d6").

address.description: For network: "IP:port", default ESC/POS port 9100 (e.g. 192.168.1.100:9100). Must be a private LAN IP or .local mDNS name (BR-P03). For usb: device path (/dev/usb/lp0, COM3).

branch.description: Printer is physically located in a specific branch.

connection_type.description: network = TCP over LAN (configurable from Cloud). usb = device path, machine-specific (BR-P04).

encoding.description: Character encoding sent to the printer. Default shift_jis (Japanese thermal printers). Vietnamese text is ASCII-folded before encoding.

is_active.description: Inactive printers are skipped by the workstation's LoadFromDB() and never receive jobs.

last_seen_at.description: Reported by the workstation after a successful connection. Lets admin-web show which printers are actually reachable in the shop.

name.description: Friendly name, unique per branch (BR-P01). Example: Kitchen Printer, Bar Printer.

paper_width.description: Thermal paper width in mm: 58 or 80. Drives the print column count (80mm = 48 cols).

roles.description: ARRAY of PrinterRole values — a printer can hold several roles at once (BR-P02). Example: ["kitchen_printer","receipt_printer"]. This is the routing key, not `type`.

is_hidden.description: Auto-set when all categories are inactive

key.description: Internal slug. Immutable once any ProductSku references this option.

position.description: 1..3. Maps to ProductSku.optionValue{N}_id. NEVER reassign once SKUs exist.

value.description: Internal slug. Avoid changing once any ProductSku references this value.

cost_price.description: Actual cost price (may be overridden from auto-calculated value).

is_cost_override.description: True when cost_price was manually set, suppressing auto-recalculation.

name.description: Auto-generated from option labels or manually entered.

optionSignature.description: Canonical string: '{val1_id}|{val2_id}|{val3_id}' (NULL → ''). Computed by app. Used for NULL-safe unique enforcement.

optionValue1.description: Value for the option at position=1. Must belong to same product's option.

optionValue2.description: Value for the option at position=2. Null if product has < 2 options.

optionValue3.description: Value for the option at position=3. Null if product has < 3 options.

recipe.description: Recipe used to produce this SKU.

recipe_multiplier.description: Scale factor for recipe (Size S = 0.8, Size L = 1.2)

selling_price.description: List/retail selling price. This is the single source of truth for the default price shown on menus. When a menu is cloned to a branch, menu_product_skus.selling_price copies from this field.

sku.description: Unique stock-keeping code. Nullable for auto-generated default SKU.

code.description: Unique code per organization (e.g., BEVERAGE, FOOD)

actual_quantity.description: Actual output recorded on completion. May differ from planned (BR-07: waste, spoilage)

approved_by_id.description: SSO user who approved this order. Null if not yet approved.

created_by_id.description: SSO user who created this order (user_caches.id). No hard FK.

outputVariant.description: FK to product_skus — the finished product being produced. Must have has_recipe = true (BR-01)

output_unit.description: Output unit from variant's base_unit (e.g., piece, portion, bowl)

planned_quantity.description: Number of finished products to produce

recipe_multiplier.description: From variant.recipe_data.multiplier. NVL = component.qty × recipe_multiplier × planned_quantity (BR-02)

status.description: Workflow: draft → pending → approved → in_progress → completed / cancelled

stock_in_transaction_id.description: FK to stock_transactions — auto-created when order completes (add output). No hard FK.

stock_out_transaction_id.description: FK to stock_transactions — auto-created when order starts (deduct components). No hard FK.

warehouse.description: Production warehouse where components are consumed and output is stored

actual_quantity.description: Actual amount used, recorded on order completion. May differ from planned.

component_type.description: material = raw material (BR-04), variant = product variant (BR-05)

material.description: Raw material component. Active when component_type = material (BR-04)

productSku.description: Product variant component. Active when component_type = variant (BR-05)

productionOrder.description: Parent production order. Items are cascade-deleted with the order.

stock_available.description: Snapshot of available stock at order creation time (for UI display only)

unit.description: Base unit for this component. Must match stock_levels.unit (BR-09)

completeness_percent.description: Percentage of affected orders that have valid customer contact (email/phone).

yield_variance_tolerance_pct.description: Allowed % drift between actual and planned yield before a reason is required. 0 = any drift requires a reason.

allow_item_edit_any_status.displayName: Allow item edit in any status

policies.desc: Shop option rows are upserted through scoped admin flows; hard delete is forbidden
Shop preference narrowing is allowed within tenant/branch authorization wrapper

current_quantity.description: Snapshot of stock quantity at alert creation/update time

material.description: Raw material. Mutually exclusive with product_sku_id

min_stock.description: Snapshot of min_stock threshold from stock_levels at alert creation. NULL when the alert was fired by allow-negative shortage on a StockLevel with no threshold configured.

productSku.description: Product variant. Mutually exclusive with material_id

approved_by_id.description: SSO user who approved this stock count. Null if not yet approved.

created_by_id.description: SSO user who created this stock count (user_caches.id). No hard FK.

scope.description: full: count all items in warehouse. partial: count selected items only.

status.description: Workflow status: draft → in_progress → pending_approval → approved / cancelled

warehouse.description: Target warehouse for this stock count

counted_quantity.description: Actual quantity counted by staff. Null until counted.

difference.description: counted_quantity - system_quantity. Positive = surplus, negative = shortage. Null until counted.

material.description: Raw material. Mutually exclusive with product_sku_id

productSku.description: Product variant. Mutually exclusive with material_id

stockCount.description: Parent stock count session. Items are cascade-deleted with the session.

system_quantity.description: Snapshot of stock level at count creation time (BR-02: never updated after snapshot)

unit.description: Unit of measurement for this item (e.g., kg, pcs, L)

alert_enabled.description: Enable stock level alerts for this item (F8)

material.description: Raw material. Mutually exclusive with product_sku_id (exactly one must be set)

materialLot.description: FK to material_lots when stock is lot-tracked. NULL = legacy stock from before plan-017 migration. RESTRICT on lot delete (plan-040 M23 — balance integrity).

max_stock.description: Maximum stock threshold (F8). Null = no limit

min_stock.description: Minimum stock threshold for alerts (F8). Null = no alert

productSku.description: Product variant. Mutually exclusive with material_id (exactly one must be set)

quantity.description: Current stock quantity in base unit. Must not be negative (BR-01)

unit.description: Base unit of measurement (e.g., kg, piece, liter)

created_at.description: Immutable timestamp. No updated_at or deleted_at by design (BR-05)

material.description: Raw material. Mutually exclusive with product_sku_id

materialLot.description: Lot whose qty_on_hand changed. Mirrors the parent StockTransactionItem. NULL = legacy/pre-lot-tracking. RESTRICT on lot delete — audit rows must keep their lot link (plan-040 M23).

movement_type.description: in = increase stock, out = decrease stock

productSku.description: Product variant. Mutually exclusive with material_id

quantity.description: Amount changed in base unit (always positive)

stockTransaction.description: Source transaction that caused this movement

approved_by_id.description: SSO user who approved this transaction. Null if not yet approved.

created_by_id.description: SSO user who created this transaction (user_caches.id). No hard FK.

reference_id.description: ID of the source record (polymorphic, no hard FK)

reference_type.description: Source type: production_order, stock_transfer, stock_count, material_batch

status.description: Workflow status: draft → pending → approved → completed / cancelled

sub_type.description: Detailed classification: purchase, sales, production, transfer, disposal, adjustment, other

base_quantity.description: Converted quantity in base unit (e.g., 100 kg). base_quantity = quantity × ratio (BR-06)

cost_basis_amount.description: Lot's unit_cost × base_quantity at consumption time. NULL for stock_in or pre-Tier-1.B legacy items.

material.description: Raw material. Mutually exclusive with product_sku_id

materialLot.description: Lot the qty was drawn FROM (stock_out, FEFO) or deposited INTO (stock_in, receive). NULL = legacy/pre-lot-tracking. Multi-lot allocations split into N rows.

productSku.description: Product variant. Mutually exclusive with material_id

stockTransaction.description: Parent transaction. Items are cascade-deleted with the transaction.

unit.description: Unit user selected (may differ from base unit)

unit_price.description: Unit price for purchase transactions only. Null for other sub_types.

approved_by_id.description: Source warehouse manager who approved the transfer.

created_by_id.description: SSO user who created this transfer (user_caches.id). No hard FK.

received_by_id.description: Destination warehouse manager who received the transfer.

stockInTransaction.description: Stock in transaction at destination warehouse

stockOutTransaction.description: Stock out transaction at source warehouse

material.description: Material being transferred. Mutually exclusive with productSku.

productSku.description: Product variant being transferred. Mutually exclusive with material.

received_base_quantity.description: Received quantity converted to base unit

received_quantity.description: Quantity received in user-selected unit. May differ from sent (BR-04).

sent_base_quantity.description: Sent quantity converted to base unit

branch.description: Denormalized from zone.branch for fast shop-scoped queries.

call_requested_at.description: Timestamp when a customer requested staff. Null means no active call. TMS shows red + bell icon.

code.description: Unique code per branch (BR-T01). Example: T-01.

is_active.description: Inactive tables cannot have their runtime status changed (BR-T03).

name.description: Optional friendly name. UI falls back to code when null.

paid_at.description: Timestamp of the last payment for this table. Used by TMS to show 'recently paid' state.

qr_token.description: Opaque random URL-safe base62 (32 chars). Unique globally (BR-T02). Frontend renders QR client-side from this string.

status.description: Runtime status. Changes via TableStatusService and logged in table_status_changes.

zone.description: RESTRICT at the DB level (BR-T04). Cascade soft-delete is handled in ZoneService::delete inside a DB::transaction.

changed_by_id.description: References user_caches.id. No hard FK because user_caches is an SSO cache (BR-TSC03).

from_status.description: Previous status. Null on the very first transition (BR-TSC02).

code.description: Unique code per brand (BR-TT01). Example: T-01. Copied to the shop table on apply-defaults.

is_active.description: Inactive templates are skipped when a shop applies brand defaults.

name.description: Optional friendly name. UI falls back to code when null.

zoneTemplate.description: RESTRICT at the DB level (BR-TT02). Cascade soft-delete is handled in ZoneTemplateService::delete inside a DB::transaction.

is_base.description: True if this is the base unit for calculation

allergen_policy.description: Allergen segregation rules for this warehouse. JSON with 'forbidden' and 'required_separate' arrays.

allow_negative_sales.description: When enabled, sales-flow stock-out can drive StockLevel.quantity below zero. Out-of-stock alert fires immediately. Manual transactions remain strict.

auto_approve_stock_in.description: Auto-approve only when Manager/Admin creates stock-in (BR-06)

code.description: Unique code per organization. Alphanumeric and hyphens only (BR-01)

disposal_approval_threshold.description: Safety net: disposals exceeding this value always require Org Admin approval, regardless of auto-approve (BR-11). Null = no limit.

is_active.description: Inactive warehouses cannot create new transactions (BR-03)

role.description: manager = view + create + approve; staff = view + create only (BR-06)

user_id.description: References user_caches.id (SSO user). No hard FK because user_caches is an SSO cache table.

code.description: Unique code per branch (BR-Z01). Alphanumeric and hyphens only.

display_order.description: Lower number appears first in the table grid.

code.description: Unique code per brand (BR-ZT01). Alphanumeric and hyphens only. Copied to the shop zone on apply-defaults.

display_order.description: Lower number appears first in the template grid.

is_active.description: Inactive templates are skipped when a shop applies brand defaults.
